germline_or_somatic: Somatic hotspot; no germline PPAP pedigree located
notes: ClinVar VCV000376500 germline classification: conflicting (checked 2026-11-20). Recurrent somatic hotspot in endometrial and colorectal cancer (Church 2013); ~50x more mutagenic than exo-null (Xing 2019; Kane & Shcherbakova 2014). A PubMed search for a germline P286R pedigree on 2026-11-21 found none (the child in Lindsay 2019 carried A456P). Nucleotide and codon verified against the full MANE CDS (CCT>CGT). The ID 36528 formerly given here was a MEN1 record

germline_or_somatic: Germline (one PPAP case) and somatic hotspot
notes: Germline: Wimmer 2017 Fam Cancer (PMID 27573199), 14-year-old boy with polyposis and rectosigmoid carcinoma. Somatic hotspot (Church 2013). ClinVar VCV001098767 germline classification: conflicting (checked 2026-11-20). Verified against the full MANE CDS (GTG>CTG). The ID 36529 formerly given here was a MEN1 record

Founding PPAP variant: Palles 2013 Nat Genet (PMID 23263490), multiple families. ClinVar VCV000040046: Pathogenic, multiple submitters, no conflicts; oncogenicity: Likely oncogenic (checked 2026-11-20). Verified against the full MANE CDS (CTC>GTC). The ID 36530 formerly given here was a MEN1 record

germline_or_somatic: Somatic hotspot; no germline PPAP pedigree located
notes: A PubMed search on 2026-11-21 found no germline S459F pedigree; Rosa 2020 (PMID 33001133) reports S459F as a somatic exonuclease-domain mutation in an ultramutated endometrial cancer from a carrier of a germline POLE frameshift (p.Pro269fs*26). ClinVar VCV002836186: Pathogenic, single submitter (checked 2026-11-20). Verified against the full MANE CDS (TCT>TTT). The earlier 'Germline' label had no source

Hansen 2015 Fam Cancer (PMID 25860647): family with cancers of colon, pancreas, ovaries and small intestine; upgraded after tumour sequencing (Rocque 2023). ClinVar VCV003340205: Likely pathogenic, single submitter (checked 2026-11-21). Verified against the full MANE CDS (TAT>TTT). Added 2026-11-21

Lindsay 2019 Cold Spring Harb Mol Case Stud (PMID 31624068): 5-year-old with CMMRD-like features and an ultra-hypermutated medulloblastoma carrying a polymerase signature; previously a recurrent somatic driver. ClinVar VCV000574902: Uncertain significance, single submitter (checked 2026-11-21). Verified against the full MANE CDS (GCC>CCC). Added 2026-11-21

Church 2013 reported S297F as a somatic exonuclease-domain mutation in endometrial cancer; no germline pedigree located on 2026-11-21. ClinVar VCV002769715: Likely pathogenic, single submitter (checked 2026-11-20). Protein change corrected from p.Ala297Val in the 2026-11-20 audit; nucleotide verified against the full MANE CDS (TCC>TTC)

First reported germline by Rohlin 2014 Int J Oncol (PMID 24788313; NM_006231.2:c.1089C>A, dominant multi-tumour family) and by Vande Perre 2019 (PMID 30368636; second family, colorectal cancer and giant cell glioblastoma). c.1089C>A is not in ClinVar; the same amino-acid change by c.1089C>G is VCV000420748, Likely pathogenic, single submitter (checked 2026-11-20). Verified against the full MANE CDS (AAC>AAA)
